identifiers.identifier_scope: Identifiers refer to 5-aza-4'-thio-2'-deoxycytidine, an investigational nucleoside analogue also developed as ASTX030 in oral cedazuridine combination programs.

drug_class: DNA methyltransferase inhibitor; hypomethylating agent; cytidine nucleoside analogue

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 5-Aza-4'-thio-2'-deoxycytidine is an investigational hypomethylating nucleoside analogue designed to inhibit DNA methylation after intracellular activation and incorporation into DNA, leading to trapping/depletion of DNA methyltransferases and re-expression of epigenetically silenced genes.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Acts as a deoxycytidine analogue that is phosphorylated intracellularly and incorporated into DNA, where it forms covalent adducts with DNA methyltransferases, producing DNMT inhibition and genome hypomethylation.
downstream_effects: Altered differentiation and apoptosis programs in malignant cells
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Class effect is primarily directed at DNMT family enzymes after DNA incorporation; isoform selectivity among DNMT paralogs was not clearly established in the located sources.

typical_use.cancer: Myelodysplastic syndromes and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
clinical_settings: Investigational treatment in adults with MDS or CMML

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Expected on-target/myelosuppressive toxicity of hypomethylating nucleoside analogues affecting proliferating marrow precursors.
Expected marrow suppression from cytidine analogue hypomethylating therapy.
Expected suppression of erythroid precursors in the setting of myelosuppressive therapy and underlying myeloid disease.
Reported/expected with oral nucleoside analogue therapy; precise mechanism not specifically established for this agent in located sources.

other_reported_adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Common nonspecific adverse effects reported with hypomethylating therapy in myeloid malignancy studies/program descriptions; agent-specific mechanistic attribution not clearly established in located sources.

drug_interactions.biological_basis: Cedazuridine inhibits cytidine deaminase to improve oral exposure of 5-aza-4'-thio-2'-deoxycytidine in combination development programs.

data_notes.record_scope: Record focuses on 5-aza-4'-thio-2'-deoxycytidine as an investigational oral hypomethylating agent, including data from development as ASTX030 with cedazuridine where explicitly attributable.
